name: DS10_FULL_MODEL_CONTRACT
reference_policy: REFERENCE_POLICY.md (2026-08-04): sealed DS8/DS9 discipline is the trusted reference; official TileLang stack is NOT a DS10 prerequisite (DS5 hardware-format blocker preserved as evidence).

gpu_topology.peer_access: not assumed; host-staged handoff is the default

handoff.method: host-staged D2D copy (pinned staging + side stream + events)
handoff.tensor: hidden state [b, s, hc_mult, dim] bf16
handoff.checksum: sha256 of exact BF16 storage bytes before and after; must be bitwise equal

precision_family.source_storage: official checkpoint: routed experts packed FP4 (I8 + F8_E8M0 scales), dense F8_E4M3 + F8_E8M0 scales, embed/head/norm BF16, hc_head F32
precision_family.dense_execution: FP16 on GPU (dequantized from official storage; DS10 family C/D hybrid)
precision_family.embed_head_execution: BF16 storage, FP32-accumulated matmuls (embed) / FP32 spot-checked head
precision_family.expert_execution: FP16-expanded active experts (sealed DS8 family C) with FP32 accumulation
precision_family.note: Explicitly NON-bitwise vs any FP32 reference; candidate-vs-reference token equality is NOT an acceptance gate.

checkpoint_access.strategy: RemoteTensorSource: per-tensor HTTP Range fetches from the pinned HF revision, offsets from the committed shard headers (48/48 committed, header hashes verified)
checkpoint_access.alternative: LocalDirTensorSource when shard files are already on disk

host: one FP16 shared-expert payload per layer

state_ownership.owner: the GPU that owns the corresponding layer; no state crosses the partition
state_ownership.dtype_shape: derived exactly from the pinned config and layer compress ratio; emitted in state signatures
state_ownership.initialization: zero for KV/state tensors; negative-infinity structural sentinel for unwritten score slots
state_ownership.update_point: inside the owning layer attention/compressor/indexer forward
state_ownership.read_point: the next prefill/decode call for the same layer
state_ownership.transfer_point: none; only hidden state transfers between GPUs
state_ownership.reset: zero/sentinel reset before every cold or deterministic run; warm run resets state but retains bounded expert cache
state_ownership.token_position: explicit start_pos from prompt length and generated-token index
state_ownership.stream_rule: owning-device current stream; explicit event chain only for the inter-GPU hidden-state handoff

staging_limits.intergpu_d2h_and_h2d_bytes: exact hidden tensor storage bytes, emitted separately

expert_cache.host_compact_reuse: official packed tensors, per-layer LRU, 8 routed experts per layer (six active plus two replacements)
expert_cache.shared_expert: cache with priority, expert_id -1 per layer
expert_cache.miss_action: on-demand fetch via RemoteTensorSource + async stage

prompts.stop: EOS token id 1 or max tokens

correctness_gates: full official tensor coverage (zero unresolved, zero duplicate)
every layer executes in order on the assigned GPU
correct state initialization + structural masks (DS9 discipline)
exact attention window/compression indices on sampled layers (DS9 exact gates)
exact selected expert SET on sampled layers (DS9 v12 set policy)
no invalid cache behavior; cold==warm output equality
no host expert fallback; native backend report per component
finite final hidden state; finite LM-head logits
valid generated token IDs (in-vocab, decoded by the DS4 tokenizer)
deterministic replay (same input + runtime -> same tokens)
bounded memory per GPU and bounded host RSS

spot_checks.reference: CPU FP32 gate recompute on candidate input
CPU FP32 head on candidate hidden state

self_consistency_checks: single-layer replay through sealed DS8/DS9 harness on DS10 hidden states

staged_runs.v1: model-load + tensor-coverage smoke (all 72,317 tensors resolve; memory plan; state init)
staged_runs.v3: inter-GPU handoff (first partition -> one layer on GPU 1)
staged_runs.final: >= 16 tokens + deterministic replay + cold/warm + bounded memory

terminal_verdict_rules.ACCEPT_DUAL_T4_FIRST_TOKEN: all layers, accepted architecture path, finite logits, one genuine token, deterministic rerun, and bounded memory
terminal_verdict_rules.ACCEPT_DUAL_T4_DECODE: at least 16 genuine autoregressive tokens, deterministic and cold/warm equality, valid state carry, no unsupported fallback, bounded memory, and complete hashed evidence
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_MODEL_LOAD: checkpoint coverage, tensor loading, state initialization, or load-time memory gate fails
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_ATTENTION_OR_STATE: first failing layer is in attention, compression, indexer, mHC, or state invariants
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_ROUTER_OR_EXPERT: routing, expert identity, cache, staging, or expert execution fails
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_INTERGPU: explicit hidden-state transfer or exact storage checksum fails
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_LM_HEAD: all layers pass but final normalization or logits fail
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_GENERATION_STATE: first token succeeds but subsequent state carry, determinism, capacity invariance, or cold/warm equality fails
terminal_verdict_rules.REJECT_MEMORY: GPU ceiling, host RSS ceiling, or bounded staging cannot be maintained
terminal_verdict_rules.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: identity, topology, instrumentation, manifest, or execution-path evidence is incomplete
